001: Lucas, can you give me a hand with this box? It's very heavy.
Of course, Ana! Just show me where you want to put it.
You can leave it over there by the table, please.
Done! Do you need anything else?
No, that's it. Thank you so much!
Don't mention it, just call if you need anything.
002: Gabriel, could you help me understand this form?
Sure, I can. Which part are you confused about?
This section here at the end, I didn't understand what I'm supposed to fill in.
Let me see... Ah, you need to put your full address.
That's right, the rest is already correct.
003: Rafael, can you do me a favor? I need to go to the bank today.
Of course, what do you need?
Could you take my son to school for me?
No problem at all. What time does he need to be there?
At seven thirty, if it's not too much trouble.
You can count on it, I'll stop by here at seven fifteen.
004: Felipe, I'm having a problem with my computer. Do you know anything about that?
A little bit, yes. What's going on?
The screen went black out of nowhere and it won't turn back on.
Have you tried holding down the power button for a few seconds?
Let me try... Wow, it worked! Thank you so much!
Great! Let me know if anything else comes up.
005: Lucas, can you help me carry these groceries to the car?
Sure, that's a lot of bags, huh?
Yeah, I ended up overdoing it at the market today.
No problem, I'll grab the heaviest ones.
You're an angel, you know that? Thank you so much!
Oh, it's nothing, it's a pleasure to help.
006: Gabriel, do you know how to get to the central library?
Yes, I do. It's near the engineering building.
Is it far from here? I'm a little lost.
It's not too far, about ten minutes on foot.
Can you show me the way? I'm afraid of getting lost.
Sure, I'll go with you there.
007: Rafael, can you review my text before I turn it in?
Sure, I can. Send it to me here.
I already sent it. Tell me if everything looks good, please.
Let me read it... It's really good! There are just a few little punctuation mistakes.
Can you fix them for me?
Of course, I'm already fixing them right now.
008: Felipe, can you lend me your charger? Mine broke.
Sure, go ahead. It's in my backpack.
Thanks! I'll leave it on your desk later.
Make yourself at home, you don't need to return it today.
Oh, that's great! You saved me.
Don't mention it, we've got to help each other.
009: Lucas, can you help me hang this picture on the wall?
Sure, but I need to check if the level is right.
I'll hold it here, you tell me if it's straight.
A little bit to the left... There, now it's perfect!
Thank you so much, I couldn't have done it without you.
Oh, it was easy. Do you need anything else?
010: Gabriel, can you give me a ride to the airport tomorrow?
Sure, I can. What time is your flight?
It's at nine in the morning, so I'd need to leave early.
No problem, I'll stop by here at seven then.
You're amazing! Can I buy you a coffee afterwards?
I'll take you up on that, but only if you let me pick the place.
